title: Air Too Late
setup: Black has just played h6 to give its king air, and nothing is left guarding the eighth rank.
hint: The back rank is no longer mate, but it is still the emptiest line on the board.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} was mate one move ago; now it is a fork. From d8 the rook hits the whole eighth rank in both directions at once — the king on one side, the bishop on c8 on the other. {{Kh7}} is forced, and {{Rxc8}} wins a piece.
